Hi Matt,

It's with your bank now rather than with us. The refund of $789.00 was issued on our side today, Monday 2 November, and banks typically take 3 to 5 business days to post it, so you should see it by the end of this week, Friday 6 November at the latest for most cards.

If it hasn't landed by then, reply here with the last four digits of the card you paid with and I'll chase it up for you.

Hope the move goes as smoothly as possible, Matt.
